Proposition
[dual weighted energy] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0077, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0078 ↗ prop:chow-ii-weighted-l2 1. ch10:10.73\group Weak heat solutions

For a subsolution of the adjoint heat equation and a weight satisfying $-\xi _t+ rac12| abla \xi |^2\le 0$, the corresponding backward weighted $L^2$ energy is nondecreasing in forward time.
Proof

\sketch Differentiate the backward weight, integrate by parts, and complete the square: the derivative is $2e^{-K_1(T_0-t)}\int | abla (ve^{\xi /2})|^2d\mu _t\ge 0$.

□
